Further investigation reveals discrepancies in her medical history provided on previous admissions.
ed visit, Emergency Medicine, Dr. Rachel Kim

This 30-year-old with schizophrenia and prior clozapine-induced seizure presents with confusion and lethargy. She has been compliant with her antipsychotic medication regimen.

Erratic behavior and talking to herself

The patient returns to the emergency department with established schizophrenia and recent encounters for clozapine-induced seizure and psychogenic polydipsia and is brought by her sister due to erratic behavior and talking to herself over the past 48 hours. She has been noncompliant with her medication regimen for the past month.

videoScripts.title: Getting Ready for Your Gynecology Visit

scenes.title: Welcome, Rachel!
scenes.voiceover: Hi Rachel, your gynecology visit is coming up soon.

scenes.title: What to Expect
scenes.voiceover: Your visit will take about 40 minutes. We may offer an exam, but it's your choice.

scenes.title: What Will Happen
scenes.text: Here is what you can expect:
items: Discuss your health and any pain
You can choose yes or no to exams
scenes.voiceover: You will talk with your care team, discuss your health, and you can choose yes or no to any exam.

scenes.title: Your Choices
items: Say yes or no to any exam
Let us know if you want to skip
scenes.voiceover: You decide what happens next. Let us know if you want to skip any part.

scenes.title: Need Help?
scenes.voiceover: If you need help, call 555-0100. We are here together.

scenes.title: Thank You, Rachel!
scenes.voiceover: Thank you for coming in, Rachel.

scenes.title: What We Talked About
scenes.text: We discussed your health and choices.
scenes.voiceover: We talked about your health and gave you choices about exams.

scenes.title: Your Next Steps
items: Let us know if you have pain
scenes.voiceover: Follow any instructions from your care team. Let us know if you have pain or questions. Review your summary.

scenes.title: When to Call
scenes.text: Call us if you have pain or feel unwell.
scenes.voiceover: Call us if you have new or severe pain, or if you feel unwell after the visit.

scenes.title: We Are Here Together
scenes.voiceover: Call 555-0100 if you need help. We are here together.
